scenes.title: Day one
scenes.hook: GTA 6 made $3.8 billion in one day
scenes.text: Two days ago, GTA 6 launched, and its publisher says it made three point eight billion dollars on day one. Here is how it all started.

scenes.title: The beginning
scenes.text: In 1997, a Scottish studio called DMA Design released the first GTA. Top down, with simple graphics.

scenes.title: Jumping into 3D
scenes.text: In 2001, GTA 3 jumped into full 3D, and created an open world design that many games copy today.

scenes.title: Neon and states
scenes.text: Vice City brought neon Miami in 2002. San Andreas followed in 2004 with an entire state to explore.

scenes.title: A darker city
scenes.text: In 2008, GTA 4 brought a darker, more realistic Liberty City, and broke sales records.

scenes.title: GTA 5
scenes.text: In 2013, GTA 5 earned eight hundred million dollars on day one, and a billion in three days.

scenes.title: Still selling
scenes.text: With GTA Online, it kept selling for over a decade, passing two hundred million copies.

scenes.title: GTA 6 is here
scenes.text: Now GTA 6 has smashed that record, with three point seven nine billion dollars, the publisher says. Which GTA was your favourite? Comment below.
